children: Productivity was up 2.2% year‑on‑year, with economists and policymakers expecting wider adoption of artificial intelligence to support future gains and help restrain inflation.
Unit labour costs rose at a downwardly revised 1.2% pace, compared with the previously reported 1.3%, while labour costs were 1.4% higher than a year earlier.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
